Enhanced prompt:

Design a hyper-realistic, exploded vertical infographic composition that captures the essence of a perfect morning coffee, with every element rendered in stunning 8K resolution.

At the peak of the composition, create a mesmerizing splash of crema, frozen in time as it cascades upwards from the center. Use advanced shading techniques to convey the delicate balance of tiny, spherical bubbles and micro-droplets, their surfaces catching the light with a subtle, iridescent sheen.

Directly underneath the crema, craft a deep, velvety layer of espresso, its rich, dark hue inviting the viewer to dive in. Ensure the liquid appears thick and viscous, with the faintest hint of a meniscus where it meets the air.

Spread across the middle ground are a handful of freshly roasted coffee beans, each one a work of art in its own right. Render the beans with painstaking attention to detailâshowcase their unique shapes, the rough, pitted surfaces, and the telltale sheen of natural oils on their surfaces. The beans should convey a sense of movement, as if they've just been scattered moments before.

Descending further, introduce a sprinkling of fine sugar crystals, their sharp, angular faces catching the light in a dazzling display of refraction. Position them so they appear to be gently floating, their tiny forms adding a delicate touch to the composition.

At the very bottom, ground the entire scene with a minimal, ceramic coffee cup base. The porcelain should be rendered with a matte finish, its surface smooth and uniform, with a slight hint of translucency where the light filters through the thin walls.

Set the composition against a pure, pristine white background, allowing the vibrant colors of the coffee to truly shine. Utilize a soft, studio lighting style to create gentle, diffused shadows beneath each floating element, adding depth and dimension to the scene.

Ensure the focus is ultra-sharp throughout, mimicking the depth of field of a DSLR macro lens. The viewer should feel they can reach out and touch the sparkling droplets and glistening coffee beans.

Include clean, elegant infographic text labels for each element, connected to the main composition by thin, stylish pointer lines. The typography should be crisp and modern, perfectly aligned with the overall premium lifestyle aesthetic.

The final output should be an 8K masterpiece, capable of being printed on huge formats without losing any detail. It should evoke the same sense of appreciation and longing for the perfect morning ritual that one might experience when admiring a photograph by a renowned coffee connoisseur.
